AUTOKERNER · SPACING STUDY
Task and method

Two proposals. The same starting point.

Task: inspect spacing rhythm and letter contacts after automatic spacing.

Original input — three examples

Imported sidebearings are left unchanged. No damage is added. Before shows the original input, not a claim that it is ideal.

Perturbed input — one example

Left and right bearings receive repeatable changes of up to ±40/1000 em. H/O/n/o and Cyrillic reference letters retain their original metrics.

Paired calculation

Autokerner defaults and FontLab 9 Neural (unlinked, value 10) receive the same input, glyph scope and reference letters.

Spacing only

Kerning and substitutions are off. All three rows use identical outlines, size and baselines. Only the metrics change.

Selected from 35 inputs across 12 families. Four local examples retained after review; they do not establish an overall ranking.

The goal is to compare proposals, not to reconstruct the original values or reverse-engineer either engine.
